title: Reference solution: Solve simultaneous equations
answer:
import numpy as np

A = np.array([[2.0, 1.0], [1.0, 3.0]])
b = np.array([5.0, 6.0])
x = np.linalg.solve(A, b)
print(x)
print(np.allclose(A @ x, b))
